name: signal_fwht
expr: ys = fwht(x); yh = fwht(x, 8, 'hadamard'); yd = fwht(x, 8, 'dyadic'); ypad = fwht(x, 16); ytr = fwht(x, 4); xr_s = ifwht(ys); xr_h = ifwht(yh, 8, 'hadamard'); xr_d = ifwht(yd, 8, 'dyadic'); err_s = max(abs(xr_s - x)); err_h = max(abs(xr_h - x)); err_d = max(abs(xr_d - x)); imp1 = fwht(e1, 4, 'hadamard'); imp2 = fwht(e2, 4, 'hadamard');
comment: MATLAB Signal Toolbox fwht/ifwht — fast Walsh-Hadamard transform pair. Radix-2 Hadamard butterfly with 1/N normalisation. Three orderings: 'sequency' (default, Walsh function order), 'hadamard' (natural Sylvester), 'dyadic' (bit-reversed natural = Paley). For length not a power of 2 with n omitted, auto-promote to next pow-2 with zero-pad; explicit n must be a power of 2. Round-trip ifwht(fwht(x)) = x to integer arithmetic. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b on all 9 probed configurations. Octave 11.1.0 ships fwht/ifwht in signal package.
